meta.description: Registry for failure modes encountered during the reconstruction of selection behavior.

failure_modes.name: reconstruction_aliasing
failure_modes.description: Multiple distinct selection rules result in identical observed continuation events.

failure_modes.name: information_loss_in_projection
failure_modes.description: Projection into observables erases the parameters needed for selection recovery.

failure_modes.name: residue_drift_ambiguity
failure_modes.description: Drift in residue history prevents unique identification of the selection context.

failure_modes.name: orientation_reversal_failure
failure_modes.description: No unique orientation frame can be reconstructed from the observed selection event.

failure_modes.name: non_invertible_branch_pruning
failure_modes.description: Branch pruning history is unrecoverable, leading to preimage explosion.
